messages:
erin_m: quick RFC follow-up re: onboarding bench verdicts. i put a tiny contract below for prober -> ingestor and the admit API shape. want quick alignment on cardinality and flaky handling.

bob_s: drop it here. prometheus must stay low-card. event stream can carry details.

erin_m: event contract (proto-like, simplified): model_id, probe_name, ts, outcome(ok|fail|warn), short_code, severity(low|med|high), input_id?, evidence_url?, fingerprint.

claire_z: fingerprint is essential. impl: sha1(model_id + probe_name + short_code + trace_prefix). stable across langs.

bob_s: prometheus names: redwood_onboard_probe_total{outcome,env} and redwood_onboard_probe_latency_seconds histogram. no model/probe labels.

erin_m: admit API suggested shape: {verdict: PASS|REVIEW|FAIL, reasons: [canonical_code...], sample_evidence_url: optional}. policy: if evidence_url missing -> REVIEW.

claire_z: dedupe logic: sliding window 10m, count distinct fingerprints, threshold default=2 for FAIL. treat infra/oom as noisy until persistent across 3 windows.
bob_s: mapping of vendor codes -> canonical should live in ingest layer and be versioned. producers encouraged to emit canonical short_code.

prober-bot: prober v0.3.2 rolled to staging; emitted 6 fails for model rmx-7b on smoke set. report: https://ci.internal/reports/4771004321/summary

erin_m: action items: erin -> short RFC example + proto sketch (EOD Wed); bob -> prometheus name doc + gate usage; claire -> bench-ingestor windowed-dedupe PR. reconvene after POC. :thumbsup:
